summary: Correct clustered-storage capability negotiation after Controller/Core reconnect (BUG-0151). API impact: changed existing error contract. Existing clustered status, setup, credential and fence routes return retryable 503 while a v2 Core awaits acknowledgement; no relay, native work, credential offer or legacy fallback occurs. A Core without clustered capability remains 409. A bounded corrected Controller-outage workload passed hashes, reboot checks, off/return progress and cleanup, but did not naturally enter the 503 branch; prior failed receipts remain failures and production acceptance is open.

guide.reason: Operators must distinguish retryable capability negotiation from persistent unsupported capability.

api.reason: API impact: changed existing error contract for the existing clustered status, apply, credential and fence routes; bounded negotiation is 503 with no dispatch, while permanently unsupported capability remains 409.

roadmap.reason: This fail-closed reconnect correction does not complete clustered-storage acceptance.

state.reason: Controller negotiation is transient and introduces no durable record; existing desired cluster state remains Core-owned.

verification.method: Independent review accepted focused Controller capability and bounded workload-consumer regressions: preflight returns 503 without dispatch, then acknowledged report permits relay. A later bounded Controller-outage workload completed six exact 600 MiB expected-hash/reboot checks, progress while Controller was off and after return, and API/native-zero cleanup. It did not naturally enter the 503 branch, and its enforced pre-boot identities were not retained for independent comparison. Prior failed outage receipts remain failures; no production or ISO claim is made.
